Name: Zero-Ohm Systems
Description:
Zero-Ohm Systems sells a disruptive technology. This passive technology
interconnects between any amplifier
and multiple loudspeakers without worrying about
amplifier speaker loads, impedance and extremely
long cables runs. This device allows users to connect
20, 30, 40 or more speakers in parallel to one
amplifier without the use of transformers.
Up until now, the ability to connect multiple speakers
in parallel was confronted by the issue of operating
the amplifier at a safe impedance. Although
there are amplifiers that operate at 4 ohms and 2
ohms safely, any effort to drive them below the
rated resistance load led to device failure.
The system is ideal for major audio applications:
arenas and stadiums, amusement parks, bars, cinemas
and theatres, reception halls, airports, cruise
ships, hotels, outdoor malls, restaurants, water
parks and more.

This allows for panel plating process, which in turn means a highly uniform surface copper distribution, excellent impedance matching results, landless via formation and superior fine line features.

This process has replaced many undesirable products and chemistries from fabrication processes found in the majority of PCB shops around the world.

We can genuinely claim to be an “environment-friendlier” company since having completely eliminated the use of formaldehyde, EDTA, dry-film resists, ammonia-based etch chemistry and tin-lead resists and their associated by-products.

At SCAN~LINK Technologies, our mission is to create safer work environments and prevent struck-by incidents. We engineer and manufacture a passive RFID-based personal detection system designed to protect people around mobile equipment in industries where visibility is a constant challenge, including construction, mining, and waste management. We are committed to providing solutions that eliminate blind spots and protect your workers.

How It Works:
Our system provides an essential layer of protection. Workers are equipped with passive RFID tags integrated into their safety vests and hard hats. Mobile equipment is fitted with an antenna that creates a detection zone. When a tagged person enters this zone, the equipment operator receives an immediate audio and visual alert inside the cab, clearly indicating a person is in a hazardous zone or blind spot. Simultaneously, an external alarm warns the worker they are in a danger zone. The system intelligently differentiates between people and tagged assets, ensuring there are zero false alarms from random objects.

Data for a Safer Future:
The SCAN~LINK system does more than just prevent incidents in real-time. It collects and stores critical detection data, including date, time, and location of the detection. This information provides actionable insights through our HMI applications interface, delivering telemetry, geofencing, and automated event reporting. By looking at these trends, you can improve safety procedures, enhance training, and build a lasting culture of safety.

To learn how our proven technology can enhance safety on your job site, contact our team.

Description:
What we do, and why.

3d printable scenery is exploding, more and more  hobbyists with printers are making their games terrain with home printers and we want to be on leading edge of this by bringing our professionalism and strong aesthetic to our customers. Are company is a partnership of two great friends founded out of the realization we cone with the exact skills needed to bring what we do to life. Dawa with his strong 3d background and James with his history in game design. 


High Quality Design Vs. Game focused Design
Our focus is on the UNITY of high quality design and strong gamer oriented functionality. A lot of other companies are focused on modularity, which sounds great can be frustrating in practice. Our view is that what you gain in modular options you lose in the piece’s charm and realism. Buildings get boxy, chunky and unwieldy, and at the end of the day once painted they aren't really modular anymore because the painting styles of the pieces don't match. So what are we doing? Simple. You know the amazing realistic scenery you drool over online and at conventions? We’re putting that in your hands. We design it you print it, paint it and wow your gamers and friends. 

Universal Approach
Non world specific designs allow you to customize the anthropological and temporal details of our models to fit into your choice of game and genre. Be it historical, fantasy, post-apocalyptic, you can fill in the details such as insignia, symbology and cultural trappings that match the worlds you game in. 

Game experience priority.
We strenuously avoid including in our key models details that can interfere with game play, such as items or tools the players can interact with. Our view is these things should be added as needed not baked into the main design. So you won’t find treasure chests, weapons, corpses, or story elements in our base designs (although we may supply alternate versions or separate pieces that include such things down the line). 


Complex World Building
We believe the heart of gaming is imagination, and the story behind things is what gives gaming life. Therefore each release we launch isn't just a single model or a bunch of random pieces they are a full set. A scene in a broader story, replete with a an optional backstory you can use as fuel to kickstart your own imagination. Each of our sets will be released with literature, stories, history and potential adventures ideas which can be used to enliven your roleplay experience.

Description:
Since 1991, Mirus International Inc. has been a supplier of specialized power quality products to reduce or eliminate harmonic problems and save energy in electrical power distribution systems worldwide. As true innovators, our unique approach to harmonic mitigation has produced many patented designs useful in addressing the problems associated with harmonic generating non-linear loads such as personal computers, telecom equipment, broadcasting equipment and Variable Frequency Drives (VFD).
Our strength is in our technical expertise as problem solvers. Principals at the company have been successfully resolving difficult power quality problems for decades. 
We are the original inventors of Harmonic Mitigating Transformers which combine low zero phase sequence impedance with phase shifting to treat harmonics generated by non-linear loads. This strategy not only improves power quality by reducing voltage distortion and flat-topping but also saves energy by lowering the harmonic losses within the transformer and upstream distribution system. 
With the introduction of our revolutionary LINEATOR Universal Harmonic Filter (UHF) in 1999, we have begun to capture a significant portion of the market for premium harmonic Variable Frequency Drive solutions. Our new generation Advanced Universal Harmonic Filter (AUHF) has built on this success and now is the solution of choice for many of the major VFD manufacturers and is being specified by many consulting engineers worldwide.

Are you prepared for a drowning in your area?
Drownings can happen anywhere—lakes, rivers, quarries, even retention ponds—and they’re rarely predictable. AquaEye is built for portability, durability, and ease of use in the field. Whether mounted on a boat or operated by hand from shore, AquaEye empowers teams to act quickly and confidently.

We work closely with fire services, law enforcement, military, and emergency response organizations to provide training, support, and tools they can rely on when lives are on the line.

Key features:

Scans up to 50 meters (165 feet) in all directions

Pinpoints human bodies using AI-powered detection

Waterproof, rugged, and field-ready

Operates in low visibility and challenging conditions

AquaEye and AquaEye Pro were created because we believe no family should wait hours—or days—to find their loved one. Join the growing number of teams who are redefining what’s possible in water rescue.

Name: BC Electrical Association
Description:
The roots of the BC Electrical Association (BCEA) go back to the 1920's. Today's BCEA, comprised of more than 145 corporate members, was started by the BC Electric Company (now BC Hydro). In 1923, our forerunner, The Electrical Service League of British Columbia (ESL), was chartered by the provincial government of the day.

Until the 1980's, the ESL was located at the BC Hydro office and was completely financed by the utility. The electrical service league had a mandate to encourage conversion to electricity, and its safe installation.

Since that time, activities of the league varied in their content and frequency. In the early 1980's, the ESL promoted electric home heating and installed the ESL 'Gold Seal' and 'Silver Seal' standards. The ESL also organized, promoted and ran a major electrical tradeshow every third year in the lower mainland.

About 1985, BC Hydro suggested the ESL should rely on them less for funding. League offices then moved from BC Hydro premises. Additional trade activities were scheduled and held around the province. An educational program was developed for members. In 1990, the Electrical Service League changed its name to the British Columbia Electrical Association, and revised its bylaws. In 2014, the BCEA celebrated it's 90th Anniversary of serving the electrical industry throughout the entire province of BC.

The result has been a significant increase in the level of member directed activity. New and innovative events were created, while flagship BCEA foundations continued to grow strongly. Our Scholarship and Bursary Program has awarded over $400,000.00 to deserving students across BC. New committees were created to help support the growing need in our industry- the U40 Group, the Women's Network and the Conference Committee. The LINK Conference grew from an idea to an educational and successful event.

These changes and additions continue to attract new members and diversify our base.

The BCEA is dedicated to helping our members achieve the highest level of success

The original cost analysis of hand dryers compared to alternatives was created by Comac founder Brian O’Connor in the 1980’s. It demonstrated that one could reasonably expect a 90% savings versus paper towel or linen over the lifetime of a Blast model or equivalent. This savings took into account the original capital cost of the dryer and installation. The lifetime of the Blast was estimated to be 10 years, the warranty at the time. This cost analysis is still in general use and remains accurate today. Claims of 90% savings over one year, on the other hand, are misleading.
There are other cost savings associated with hand dryers: 
They eliminate the cost of combating and repairing vandalism related to paper towel. Paper is often used to clog toilets and sinks or is set on fire in institutional and industrial settings, incurring hefty costs. 
Hand dryers eliminate the labor costs associated with paper and linen, including regular purchasing, inventory and stocking, re-filling dispensers, general washroom clean up, garbage disposal labor and the extra disposal cost of the paper. It is generally agreed that up to one hour of labor is associated with every case of paper towel. In contrast, Comac hand dryers are always on duty and require virtually no maintenance.

Name: Marathon Electric – Motors and Generators
Description:
Marathon has a history of over 110 years of making Motors & Generators. Encompassing thousands of products and solutions found in some of the most demanding industrial applications around the world.

A History Of Industry Leadership

Marathon started in 1913 as Marathon Electric in Wausau, Wisconsin, USA. In a converted logging mill on Plumer's Island, the young company made its first product, a single phase 115VAC, 1/4 horsepower washing machine motor.

After a few years as a fledgling motor manufacturer, inventor Austin Kimble took over as general manager. Kimble introduced new production methods and products based on his patents. With mixed results, Marathon's portfolio expanded into fans, talking movies, and metered washing machines. During the 1930s, the company reorganized as Marathon Electric Manufacturing Corporation and turned profits during the Great Depression.

Marathon expanded in the following decades. New production plants opened and Marathon purchased Pennsylvania-based Burke Electronics in 1949. This purchase allowed Marathon to enter into the generators, fuse, and terminal block fields.

Kimia has developed the first-ever mobile testing platform for rapid onsite quantification of total PFAS, fluorine, and other chemical elements. PFAS (per- and poly-fluoroalkyl substances) are emerging contaminants that have wildly polluted the environment. While legacy technologies can detect only up to 40 out of over 10,000 PFAS, we have pioneered the Hybrid ICP-3Q-MS: the world’s first compact, mobile, ultra-sensitive mass spectrometer that quantifies the total PFAS load in samples through our proprietary fluorine testing method in alignment with US-EPA's goal in this area. We have several patents, know-how, and trade-secrets. With significant savings in operational costs and sample preparation time compared to legacy methods, our technology reduces the cost and time of analysis per sample by a factor of 10 enabling testing labs to be able to cope with the overwhelming demand for PFAS testing. 

Our technology addresses a TAM of over $21 billion, with an estimated SOM of $1 billion. It can be utilized at military bases and airports, where the use of aqueous film-forming firefighting foams containing PFAS has caused significant water contamination. Additional applications include monitoring landfill leachate, paper mills, wastewater treatment plants, land and urban runoff, and industries such as textile waterproofing, metal finishing and plating, carpet and furniture production, and more.

Our team has a century of combined experience in commercializing innovative technologies, with 3 successful companies, 90+ patents, and 500+ publications in our portfolio. Our platform aims to be the first to address significant data gaps and technological barriers in tackling the global PFAS crisis.

By investing in smart battery charging solutions, we’re not only cutting down on energy use but also reducing the environmental impact of battery production and disposal.  Prolonged battery life means fewer replacements, leading to less raw material extraction and waste generation. Additionally, refurbishing and repurposing older chargers supports a circular economy, ensuring resources are reused effectively. When combined with sustainable energy sources, these technologies empower industries to operate in a greener, more responsible way. 

Battery Management systems in Action 

Battery  management systems bring intelligence to the charging process by monitoring battery health, predicting maintenance needs, and optimizing charging schedules based on usage patterns.  This predictive capability reduces downtime and maintenance costs, allowing companies to keep their equipment running efficiently. BMS also streamlines inventory management by tracking usage data and ensuring that each battery and charger is utilized to its full potential, saving time, resources, and minimizing waste.

How It Works

Our technology autonomously cooks using a modified reverse-sear method for food that’s juicy on the inside and crispy on the outside. Name: I-Gard Corporation

Electrical hazards such as ground faults, arc flashes, electrical shock impact industry on a daily basis from interrupting processes, damaging equipment and posing a safety risk to personnel but we have the a solution to each.

For process facilities concerned about process interruptions, equipment damage, the risk of arc flash that solution is High Resistance Grounding which 
is recognized by  NFPA 70E, CSA ZA462 and the National Electrical Code as a technology that reduces the probability of an arc flash hazard. At I-Gard we take safety one step further by adding optical arc flash mitigation to our HRG systems to reduce probability and impact of an arc flash.

For users who cannot for practical reasons convert to HRG technology, we offer ground fault and arc flash protection relays to minimize the impact of an arc flash.

For facilities concerned about electric shock we have available both our shock protection panels as well as our new UL labeled Absence of Voltage Tester.

Of course our history is as a power resistor company and we continue to offer a full range of dynamic braking, neutral grounding and motor control resistors all manufactured under the CSA SMTC program.

Our focus on safety extends to education and awareness and is demonstrated though our partnerships with media companies at providing education editorials, application white papers and our active participation on industry safety and standards panels. 

When you need electrical safety products, whether protecting your personnel, your key processes or your electrical equipment such as transformers, switchgear and generators, you can trust I-Gard to have the Power to Protect.

Description:

Used by the world's leading wind turbine manufacturers, FT wind sensors have passed over 30 independent tests that include water ingress, ice, corrosion, sand, dust, hail, vibration, drop and lightning protection.

Acu-Res technology is FT's proprietary technology utilising acoustic resonance and is inherently different to Time-of-Flight (ToF). Unlike other ultrasonic sensors, FT wind sensors measure the phase change of acoustic waves to calculate airflow speed and direction. This ensures reliability in wind speed, direction and temperature data in the harshest of conditions.

Name: Nanalysis
Description:
Nanalysis Scientific Corp. (TSXV:NSCI, FRA:1N1, OTC:NSCIF), is a global developer, manufacturer and seller of innovative Magnetic Resonance (NMR) technologies. They released their flagship product, the first portable, high-resolution 60 MHz benchtop NMR spectrometer on the market in 2013, and then introducing the market-leading 100 MHz spectrometer in 2019.  Designed with flexibility, these compact platforms can be configured as traditional NMR spectrometers or programmed as analyzers for specific industrial applications (e.g., oil and gas, chemical, pharma, biotech, food science, atomic agencies, cannabis, mining).
 
Nanalysis expanded its portfolio of magnetic resonance technology by acquiring RS2D, founded in 2004, with a specialization in high-performance magnetic resonance electronics.  Their superior and versatile Cam4TM technology powers a range of magnetic resonance products from benchtop NMR to high-field NMR consoles to preclinical and clinical MRIs. 
 
In 2021, Nanalysis acquired One Moon Scientific and its NMRFx software, that specializes in streamlining in data analysis and management of small and macromolecules. One Moon Scientific provides data processing and aids niche areas in MR data analyses with machine learning and database search or construction algorithms. 
 
In 2022, Nanalysis also added K’Prime as a subsidiary to help expand the reach and response time of its sales and service division. With headquarters in both Phoenix and Calgary, K’Prime is a leader in sales and services providing for a clientele in scientific instrumentation sales and maintenance in security, pharma, oil & gas, food, and chemical production.

Description:
Bringing Touch to Life in Invisible Interfaces
Boréas Technologies makes touch interfaces feel real, especially where visual confirmation isn't possible or safe.

We develop solid-state button systems that add localized haptic feedback and force sensing to touch surfaces. Our technology delivers precise tactile confirmation exactly where users touch.

Solving critical safety and usability challenges:
In AI glasses and automotive applications, haptic feedback is essential. AI glasses users navigate invisible controls they can't see—without tactile feedback, they're left guessing whether their input registered. In automotive displays, drivers need to confirm inputs without taking their eyes off the road, but today's surfaces offer no feedback, forcing them to glance down. Our localized haptic technology provides instant feedback exactly where fingers make contact, eliminating guesswork and enabling safer interactions.

Elevating product experiences:
In smartphones and consumer electronics, haptic feedback transforms interactions into memorable experiences. A camera button mimicking a professional shutter trigger. A volume slider with distinct tactile zones. These details make products feel premium and increase brand value. Our technology enables OEMs to create haptic signatures that differentiate their products.

What makes us different:
Feedback so sharp and localized that experts need to disconnect our demos to believe it

Description:

The company concentrates on improving the visibility and efficiency in power system through utilization of Internet of Things (IoT) and Big Data Analysis. SilverFern invests millions of US dollars in R&D every year.  Tens of thousands of smart grid sensors have been successfully deployed in Ultra High Voltage (UHV) system and medium voltage distribution network for real-time monitoring, power quality analysis, assets performance management, equipment failure diagnosing,distribution fault anticipation based early warnings, and fault detection and location.

Our Solution: LinePatrol Smart Grid Sensor (SGS) + SFPlatform Cloud-based Big Data Analytical Platform

SGS is an inductively self-powered intelligent device, easy to install and maintenance free. Unlike the traditional power line sensors and FCIs, the wide-area timing synchronization and high-precision measurement are introduced in SGS. Providing previously unavailable critical information such as phasors, SGS helps utilities to gain visibility and improve efficiency for a more reliable grid. The operation cost can be greatly reduced. SFPlatform stores and analyzes all the data and event waveforms collected by SGSs and sends notifications of the faults, disturbances, exceptional unbalances and harmonics information immediately via SMS or APP. The system can be used to predict power failures and be extended to the distribution automation applications of Wide Area Monitoring Systems (WAMS) with dynamic line rating, power flows and line loss computation etc. to further increase the visibility of distribution grids. 
* 1us wide-area timing sync. err, 256 samples/cycle, 0.5 grade measurement
* Easy installation via hot stick, 5A line current at full operation
* High accuracy single-phase earth fault detection and location
* Suitable for various kinds of neutral grounding systems

DEIS is the Dielectrics and Electrical Insulation Society whose field of interest includes the study and application of dielectrics from the molecular level, through nano-structured materials, to insulation systems in industrial, commercial, and power system equipment, to emerging applications such as those at high power levels and in biological and other small-scale systems. Name: Blue Box Technology BBT
Description:
Blue Box Technology (BBT) is a Canadian owned company offering a product which recycles waste heat to generate electricity. The electricity can be used on-site to conserve energy or be sold back to the grid. The system is a skid mounted module that takes advantage of existing heat flows from an industrial process.

The BBT module consists of four main components:
• Air Compressor
• Waste Heat Exchanger
• Turbine Expander
• Generator

The product is a compact simple system that is easily installed and interconnected. Both compression and expansion take place in rotating machinery. The working fluid is air, the source of heat is a continuous waste heat stream, and the turbine drives a generator which creates electricity.  Waste heat can be found in several industries including: Hazardous Waste, Petrochemical, Pulp and Paper, Foundries, Open Air Furnaces, Chemical, Cement and Wood Product Manufacturing. The BBT module has a low capital and operating expense, with very little maintenance required; it has high reliability with up-times of 98% and reduces the carbon intensity of the facility.

Fight Climate Change with Existing Resources
Cutting greenhouse gases by reducing our carbon footprint is the responsibility of world leaders, corporations, industry, and individuals.  As a start, it makes sense to use “existing” resources, better.

Blue Box Technology offers an independent piece of equipment to easily integrate into an existing industrial process.  This will allow customers to conserve electricity with otherwise wasted heat.

Free Engineering Analysis
Whatever the needs of the customer, whether it be power generation, improved process efficiency, or reducing the carbon footprint, the BBT unit can deliver results.  BBT is offering free engineering analysis.  The report will include the generation potential of waste heat, any incentives and carbon offsets within your geographical location.

Contact Us Today!

Smart TweezersTM is a handheld electronic tool of a new concept. Its unique design combines a pair of gold-plated SMD tweezers with ergonomic shielded handles and a precise full featured LCR impedance meter in a compact, lightweight instrument. Smart TweezersTM identify both marked and unmarked SMD-components with easy probing of all types of passive SMD and through-hole devices. The instrument measures capacitance, inductance and resistance with speed and precision along with secondary parameters such as capacitor ESR (ESR Meter), Q (quality factor), D (dissipation factor) and Z (impedance) measurements are also provided. Smart TweezersTM LCR meter proves itself as an indispensable tool for SMT component sorting, in-circuit and on-board impedance testing and product debugging.

Smart TweezersTM provides a perfect solution for testing and identification of Surface Mount Devices (SMD) as well as for troubleshooting of complex electronic systems.

Name: OptoElectronic Components
Description:
OEC is a trusted partner with a deep understanding of Photon Counting Detectors and Applications. We provide detectors from Micro Photon Devices with 30ps timing resolution, superior detection efficiency, low dark counts and low afterpulsing. We sell PicoQuant’s Multichannel Picosecond Event Timers: PicoHarp 300, HydraHarp 400, MultiHarp series that have up to 64 detector channels and the TimeHarp 260. These products are very powerful and versatile because each channel is independent and can “time-tag” the photon.

We also sell Single Photon Counting detectors based on Superconducting Nanowires from Quantum Opus, which now offer a complete wall-plug portable system that has a one push button cool-down. New to the product offering is a Single Photon Source from Quandela. Quandela are experts in the fabrication of performing devices for the research in quantum photonics and quantum information. They fabricate unique solid-state sources of quantum light and opto-electronic modules for the interface with fiber based systems and integrated photonic circuits. 

A Photonic Processor from QuiX Quantum for Quantum Computing and Quantum Networking. The photonic processors offered by QuiX Quantum are universal multimode tunable interferometers. Photonic processors allow arbitrary, user-defined interference to occur between a series of light fields. The processor consists of a series of optical waveguides which contain the light and define the optical modes. These waveguides are brought into controlled contact, which implements the desired operation. The layout is chosen such that any desired linear optical transformation can be implemented.

Finally, we sell a novel interferometer from NIREOS as an add-on to the Photon Counting detectors and TCSPC electronics to provide a Time-Emission Spectra for applications like Time-Resolved Photoluminescence.

Name: Norme québec
Description:
Norme Québec est un organisme indépendant spécialisé dans l’élaboration de normes et la certification de conformité. Sa mission est de structurer les pratiques, renforcer la confiance et soutenir la performance des organisations à travers des référentiels rigoureux, développés selon une approche collaborative et fondée sur le consensus des parties prenantes.

L’organisation intervient principalement dans la conception de normes sectorielles, de spécifications techniques et de guides de bonnes pratiques, en mobilisant des experts issus de différents milieux. Cette démarche permet de produire des documents crédibles, adaptés aux réalités du terrain et alignés sur les meilleures pratiques reconnues, notamment à l’échelle internationale.

En parallèle, Norme Québec offre des services de certification permettant d’évaluer de manière indépendante la conformité de produits, de services ou de systèmes à des exigences établies. Le processus de certification repose sur des étapes structurées, incluant l’analyse de la demande, l’évaluation, la revue technique, la décision et la surveillance, dans une logique d’impartialité et de transparence. L’organisation s’inscrit dans une perspective d’alignement avec les exigences de la norme ISO/IEC 17065.

Norme Québec se distingue par son positionnement clair : elle n’offre pas de services de consultation, afin de préserver son indépendance et la crédibilité de ses activités. Son rôle est d’encadrer, de structurer et de certifier, en assurant une séparation des fonctions et une gouvernance rigoureuse.

Par son approche agile, sa capacité à mobiliser les acteurs clés et son ancrage dans les enjeux actuels des secteurs économiques, Norme Québec vise à devenir une référence incontournable en matière de normalisation et de certification au Québec. Pour toute information ou pour discuter d’un projet, il est possible de communiquer avec l’équipe à l’adresse info@normequebec.ca

Description: Prestige Homes pioneered the concept of custom designed homes in Atlantic Canada in 1973. Along with a strong Atlantic Provinces and U.S. market, the firm has developed products that meet housing needs around the world. Homes have been shipped to the Middle East, Japan, China, The Netherlands, Romania, Russia and Germany. In September of 1995, we shipped homes to Germany that were shipped completely finished, the modular homes were shipped in two halves and the mini homes in one piece. They were rolled inside a vessel`s hold and delivered to the destination in Germany intact. This was the first venture of its kind for the Port of Saint John. Most homes shipped off-continent are built in wall sections and components small enough to be shipped in 40 ft., containers. In 1997, Prestige built and shipped fifty executive-style homes in this manner to China for the Shanghai Links Project. Canadian Housing has a good reputation around the world and People recognize Canadian Houses as being both cost effective in terms of its common wood-frame construction and energy efficient for cold climate. One of our Panelized homes was the winner of the New Brunswick Home Builders Association's "New Single Family Home" award for 1999. Name: Afterguard Marine
Description:
Afterguard System Makes America’s Cup HUD Technology Accessible 

Sailboat racing has evolved with the technology era and is now driven by data and instrumentation. The difference between winning and losing is the ability to adapt a carefully orchestrated plan to the ever-changing natural and competitive environment, faster than the competition. Having the right information at the right time can be that difference.

The Afterguard system, with patent pending technology, provides this information by combining a fighter pilot style HUD with boat instrumentation data to give the best situational intelligence and performance metrics at a glance, on a small display mounted on sunglasses made for the harshest of environments. A number of screens and features are available to the user:

StartSequence

At a glance the user will know with certainty how the boat is tracking to the start line, freeing the crew to concentrate on the speed build and competition, for the perfect start. This is made possible by the intelligent time-to-kill metric that uses the boat’s current heading and speed to calculate the exact amount of time the boat must kill before crossing the line precisely at the gun. 

Performance Dashboard

The Performance Dashboard displays the relevant information to any given crew member, from the helmsman to the trimmer. Metrics include:
•	Boat speed
•	Speed over ground
•	Wind angle (true and relative)
•	Wind speed (true and relative)
•	Polar targets
•	Heel
•	Depth

Virtual Tactician

Virtual Tactician removes the guesswork associated with making a mark or clearing a boat. By tracking the user’s gaze and combining it with the system’s data the user will be able to make split second tactical decisions without relying on a hand bearing compass, lines marked on the deck or other basic means. Simply put, the user will be able to look at another boat and gauge whether they are ahead and whether there is room to cross.

The manufacturing plant as well as the show home/office is settled in Economy, Nova Scotia, at the beautiful coastline of the Minas Basin(Bay of Fundy). We will be involved, personally in all phases of planing, design, delivery and construction of a home, if so desired by the customer. Kenomme Log Homes are built from Northern White Cedar. White Cedar needs neither preservatives nor pressure treating. White Cedar is highly resistant to decay and insects, which means that no chemical treatment of the logs is needed. However, the logs can be stained and in fact hold the stain very well to keep it's natural colour. Cedar is much less prone to checking and cracking than other woods and the cracks that do occur are less deep. If external preservatives or sealants are used, checking is further reduced. Kenomee's patented precision milling will turn the log into a smooth, round shape with a double tongue and groove joining and sealing system. This profile creates an airlock for additional insulation and a beautiful finish. Spikes are driven approximately every two feet to fasten the logs together. The air dried logs keep the shrinking and settling at it's absolute minimum - less than 1" on an 8' wall, which our building techniques will allow for. Precision milling also makes Kenomee's saddle notch corners air-tight. Each log is connected with a dovetail-spline to ensure a tight fit for the butt-joints. Kenomee Log Homes offers three different sizes of logs - 6", 7" and 8" in diameter. Next to a wide variety of standard plans, we also custom design to individual taste. Once a design is approved, Kenomee can usually ship a home within 4-6 weeks. A standard 8' exterior shell can be erected by 4 people in 16 hours. The customers have several options to build a Kenomee Log Home: - they may have KLH handle all of the details, so they can move into a completely finished home - they may wish to hire their own contactors or one of our network of authorized Kenomee contractor, or - they may prefer to do all or some of the work themselves.
